title: Overview
sentences: Hi, let's take a quick look at this loan risk dashboard.
We can enter a person's details, check their risk score, and understand how the model arrived at the result.

title: Portfolio analytics
sentences: First, this page gives us an overview of the applicants.
We can see repayment results and compare groups by income, education, and other details.

title: Financial details
sentences: Now, let's enter the yearly income and the loan amount.
We can also add other loan details and the goods price, if that information is available.

title: Applicant profile
sentences: Next, we fill in the age, work experience, family details, and housing information.
Once these basic details are ready, we can move to the risk check.

title: Run the assessment
sentences: If we have external credit scores, we can enter them here.
Otherwise, we can leave these fields blank and click Assess risk.

title: Prediction result
sentences: Here, the estimated chance of default is seven point six percent.
The risk score is eight out of one hundred, which falls in the low risk group.

title: Interpret the result
sentences: This is only an estimate. It does not guarantee what will happen.
A person still needs to review the result before making a lending decision.

title: Explain the prediction
sentences: Now, let's see what is behind the prediction.
This page shows the main factors used by the model, along with a breakdown for this applicant.

title: Compare models
sentences: Here, we compare different models using cross validation.
X G Boost is selected, and we can check the comparison and tuning details on this page.

title: Check performance
sentences: Next, we check the model's test results and performance charts.
These help us see how well the model works and how its scores behave.

title: Methodology and reference
sentences: The methodology page explains the formulas used in the dashboard.
The feature reference tells us what each input means and how missing details are handled.

title: Model information
sentences: Finally, we can check the model version and training details.
So, we can go from applicant details to a risk estimate, and review the information behind it.
